headline: Interviews for the Fire Marshal position in executive session, with reports from the chief and commissioner.
summary: Interviews will be held with Joseph Anderson, Brian Gagnon, and Julio Lopes for the Fire Marshal job, if the town attorney recommends an executive session. The agenda also includes public comment, a personnel roster, and the Fire Marshall Office Report.
items: Good and welfare of the department
Executive session for Fire Marshal interviews: Joseph Anderson, Brian Gagnon, Julio Lopes
location: Legislative Council Chambers, Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
FIRE COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
6:00 PM, NOVEMBER 18, 2026 
 
 
Memorial Town Hall 
2372 Whitney Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Fire Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold a Regular Meeting 
on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 6:00 PM via Zoom and in person at the Legislative 
Council Chambers in the Memorial Town Hall. 
  
Comments for this meeting can be made by joining the meeting and participating in the 
public input session. You will have 3 minutes to speak. Or you can write in and send them 
to HBC_Fire@Hamden.com. 
 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/86188103522 
Meeting ID: 861 8810 3522 
  
Dial In: +1 646.558.8656 US (New York) 
Participants without Zoom access may still be able to join the meeting in listen-only mode 
by (1) dialing the above number and (2) entering the meeting ID: 861 8810 3522 (3) 
followed by #.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
 A. Regular Meeting October 21st, 2026 
      
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE FROM CHIEF S. CARTER 
 
6. REMARKS FROM COMMISSIONER G. TINNEY 
 
  A. Personnel Roster 
  B. Fire Marshall Office Report 
  C. Good and Welfare of the Department
D. Citizen Complaints 
7. OLD BUSINESS 
 
8. NEW BUSINESS 
 
9. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
  A. Executive Session for the purpose of conducting interviews for the Fire Marshal 
position.  
    1. Joseph Anderson 
    2. Brian Gagnon 
    3. Julio Lopes 
10. RECONVENE FROM EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
